clips.caption:
A SWAT team put ladies on the floor of a vitamin warehouse at gunpoint, screaming for contraband. What they found was a bottle of calcium with one wrong word on the label. That was the whole case.

The cameras were already outside when it happened - timed for the evening news, not the courtroom. The photo that ran was five years old, taken fishing. Didn't matter. You weren't shown evidence. You were shown an image, and it convinced you before a single fact arrived.

Afterward, strangers in the street called him a drug dealer. He'd just been raided for a vitamin.
